items.title: Point agents at a short summary of the architecture review instead of the whole 50 KB file

checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && mkdir -p "$tmp/server/tests" "$tmp/docs" && cp server/pyproject.toml "$tmp/server/" && cp server/tests/test_docs.py "$tmp/server/tests/" && cp docs/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md docs/ARCHITECTURE-SUMMARY.md "$tmp/docs/" && printf '\n### A15. Probe heading without an index line\n' >> "$tmp/docs/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md" && { timeout 600 uv run pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider "$tmp/server/tests/test_docs.py" -k architecture_summary 2>&1 || true; } | grep -F "omits ['A15. Probe heading without an index line']"

grep -F 'Read [docs/ARCHITECTURE-SUMMARY.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE-SUMMARY.md) first,' AGENTS.md && grep -F 'that the issue touches, found by heading.' AGENTS.md && grep -F 'their lines in the summary' AGENTS.md && grep -F 'proposed architecture and stay within the current issue' AGENTS.md

git diff --stat 08c7387444fe27c87ff6f8450a2693e204bdefc2 760eee71c50b17b27acb6db49db4df506544bca3 && out=$(git diff --name-only 08c7387444fe27c87ff6f8450a2693e204bdefc2 760eee71c50b17b27acb6db49db4df506544bca3) && test -z "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -vxF -e AGENTS.md -e docs/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md -e docs/ARCHITECTURE-SUMMARY.md -e server/tests/test_docs.py -e docs/tasks/157-point-agents-at-a-short-summary-of-the-architecture-review-instead-of-.md || true)" && test "$(git diff --numstat 08c7387444fe27c87ff6f8450a2693e204bdefc2 760eee71c50b17b27acb6db49db4df506544bca3 -- docs/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md)" = "$(printf '1\t0\tdocs/ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md')"
uv run --project server ruff format --check server/src server/tests && uv run --project server ruff check server
